ideas.trend: Better HTTP/1 connection reuse in Go 1.27
boxes: Migrating the entire stack to HTTP/3 and gRPC
Waiting for Go 1.27 so HTTP/1.1 connections get reused better
ideas.caption:
Why rebuild your entire networking architecture when the Go compiler can just squeeze extra life out of a protocol from 1997.

#programmerhumor #techmemes #codingmemes #devlife #memes
ideas.why: Developers would rather wait for minor runtime optimizations on legacy protocols than migrate to modern ones.
